text: The authors report that process supervision, which gives feedback on each intermediate reasoning step, significantly outperforms outcome supervision, which gives feedback only on the final result, for training reward models on the MATH dataset; their process-supervised model solves 78% of problems from a representative MATH test subset. They also report that active learning significantly improves the efficacy of process supervision and release PRM800K, 800,000 step-level human feedback labels.
title: Process supervision (step-level feedback) outperforms outcome supervision on MATH
